content: Gone are the days when you could just buy your father a random tie or some leather-clad alcohol vessel or a shaving kit. Dads want — nay, deserve — something memorable. Luckily for you, it’s not that hard to find something special that he’ll approve of, and we’re here to guide you. We’ve curated this year’s gift list with the modern father in mind, whether he’s a gamer, creator, chef, or simply a gadget lover. There’s a lot in here we think he’ll like, from noise-canceling headphones like the Sonos Ace Ultra and an autonomous drone to a brilliant QD-OLED monitor and a nifty light that’s perfect for illuminating his next campsite. Whatever your dad is into, we’ve got you covered. chineseContent: 你可以随意给父亲买一条领带、一些皮革包覆的酒精容器或剃须套件的日子已经一去不复返了。爸爸们想要——不，应该——一些值得纪念的东西。对你来说幸运的是，找到他会认可的特别的东西并不难，我们会在这里指导你。我们在策划今年的礼物清单时考虑到了现代父亲的需求，无论他是游戏玩家、创作者、厨师，还是只是一个小玩意儿爱好者。我们认为这里有很多东西他会喜欢，从 Sonos Ace Ultra 等降噪耳机和自动无人机，到出色的 QD-OLED 显示器和非常适合照亮他下一个露营地的漂亮灯。无论您的父亲喜欢什么，我们都能满足您的需求。 [产品：戴森 PencilVac Fluffycones | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G6NBBX1C/?tag=theverge02-20， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fdyson-pencilvac-fluffycones-cordless-vacuum-black-black%2FJ3ZCSY2Y47%2Fsku%2F6669049%2F， https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dyson.com%2Fvacuum-cleaners%2Fcordless%2Fpencilvac%2Ffluffycones] [产品：吸血鬼工具多用途螺丝拔出钳（6.25 英寸）| https://www.amazon.com/VAMPLIERS-Extractor-Non-Slip-Multi Purpose-Fasteners/dp/B006YJKAPQ?tag=theverge02-20，https://vampiretools.com/product/vampliers-6-25-screw-extraction-pliers/] [产品：Peak Design City背包（15L）| https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.peakdesign.com%2Fproducts%2Fcity-backpack%3FSize%3D15L%26Color%3DMoon， https://rei.pxf.io/c/482924/1448521/17195?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rei.com%2Fproduct%2FC12665%2Fpeak-design-city-backpack-15-l%3Fsku%3DC126650001， https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bhphotovideo.com%2Fc%2Fproduct%2F1
